notes.title: Mu Cartographer is seeking and playing without words
notes.notes: Sometimes depression hits you so hard and so fast you barely have time to blink before it stuffs you into a sack and takes away your ability to communicate thoughts properly. That is why today is Mu Cartographer [official site] video day because I don’t have enough words for everything I need to do and Mu Cartographer doesn’t need me to do words. Parts of this are searching for the treasures buried on the map and parts are just playing with the landscape. I’m hoping it is a useful game for other people too. … [visit site to read more]
